measurement_definitions.target_wake: A confirmed wake counts only when at least the configured number of above-threshold KWS score windows overlap the labeled target wake audio.
measurement_definitions.target_intent: An intent counts only when runtime emits it from command capture armed by that target wake and its decision is available from target-command start through three seconds after its end.
measurement_definitions.end_to_end_pass: Target wake detected AND its associated command intent matches the label.
measurement_definitions.safe_scene_pass: End-to-end pass AND no other intent/action event occurs in the scene.
measurement_definitions.decision_latency: Measured when the full Stage 1 context window is available (clamped to scene end), not at its center.
measurement_definitions.false_event_rates: Not extrapolated per hour; this proxy is too short for a defensible rate estimate.

limitation: This is a continuous full-cascade engineering proxy. It uses the same runtime path and includes target wake, labelled command, passenger wake, passenger non-wake speech, and multichannel CAVEMOVE noise, but the target wake and command are cross-corpus clips rather than a natural same-speaker pair.

truth.speaker_consistency_note: The target wake clip and target command come from different public corpora; the command speaker is not verified to be the Marvin speaker.
